title: Been working on multiplayer FPS/spacefight hybrid game (raw gameplay footage)
author: Nuaua

comments.author: Nuaua
comments.body:
I've been working on this FPS/space game for fun, inspired by old-school games like unreal tournament, tribes, CS & natural selection, with a touch of spaceship fights. Two planets, two teams, you travel by dropship or other spaceships from one to the other, if you make it alive you commander (which has a RTS view) can drop a phase gate so the invasion can continue. First team to destroy the other team reactor wins. It's supposed to be fun first, but also have the depth of a competitive game.

I have a playable demo with a server, goal is 32-128 players. That's not my first game prototype but I have to say this one is quite fun to play, even with bots. There's an ok gameplay loop but it needs a bit more depth. I'd like to have more player cooperation too but it's a bit hard to design & test these type of things alone. Art and level design are left quite simplistic for now.
